name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) Tele-Law Helpline
service: Free Legal Consultation, Pre-litigation Mediation & Pro-Bono Advocate Allocation
eligibility: Women, children, persons in custody, industrial workmen, and citizens with income under prescribed limits under Sec 12 of LSA Act, 1987
address: B-Block, Additional Office Complex, Supreme Court of India, New Delhi - 110001

name: Chennai District Legal Services Authority (DLSA)
service: Free Pre-Litigation Mediation, Rent Dispute Conciliation & Lok Adalat
eligibility: All residents facing civil disputes, tenancy issues, family discord, or financial claims under statutory limits
address: City Civil Court Buildings, High Court Campus, Chennai – 600104

name: Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority (TNSLSA)
service: Appellate Legal Assistance, High Court Legal Services Committee
eligibility: General public seeking state-level legal aid or statutory remedy
address: North Fort Road, High Court Campus, Chennai – 600104

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Helpline (I4C)
service: Immediate reporting of financial fraud, unauthorized debits, online extortion, identity theft
eligibility: Any citizen victimized by digital or online fraud
address: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre, Ministry of Home Affairs, New Delhi

name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
service: Grievance registration against defective products, deficient services, withheld deposits or refund refusal
address: Department of Consumer Affairs, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi

name: National Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
service: Immediate Police, Fire, and Medical emergency response
eligibility: Any citizen in immediate danger or distress
address: Emergency Operation Centers across all States and UTs

name: Women Helpline (WHL) - One Stop Centre Scheme
service: 24/7 toll-free support for women facing violence, harassment, shelter needs or legal aid
eligibility: Any woman or child in distress
address: Ministry of Women and Child Development, New Delhi & District One Stop Centers

name: Hyderabad District Legal Services Authority (DLSA)
service: Free Legal Aid, Consumer Mediation & Lok Adalat
eligibility: Eligible residents under Sec 12 of LSA Act
address: City Civil Court Complex, Purani Haveli, Hyderabad – 500002

name: Delhi State Legal Services Authority (DSLSA)
service: Free Legal Representation, 24x7 Legal Helpline & Lok Adalats
eligibility: All eligible persons under Section 12 of Legal Services Authorities Act
address: Central Office, Rouse Avenue Court Complex, Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Marg, New Delhi
